statement: Let c be the terminal coefficient array obtained from d by the synthesis and sampling map of Theorem 3.4, with any fixed permitted output mask. For every sufficiently large dyadic N, 0 < κ < 1/10, 0 < η ≤ 1, and 0 < s ≤ 1, put γ0 = 10κ + η + 3s/2. Then X ν′,z′,j |cν′,z′,j|3 ≤ CN6 P(κ, η)M(s)3/2 Nγ0 log2 (2 + N)δ2 X ν bν(d)3/2 . (4.9) The constant C and the lower threshold for N are independent of κ, η, s. Their dependence is only on the fixed phase, windows, and label bounds; all additional parameter dependence is contained in P(κ, η) and M(s).
